failure_and_repair_process.scope: Public acceptance ends an arm even if its held-out grade fails. Initial public passes are ineligible for the rollback comparison. First-repair correctness and final accepted correctness are distinct observed endpoints.

shared_lesson_content.scope: One categorical lesson per eligible prefix is shared by KL and RL. Counts describe saved hints, not truth, independent treatment replicates, or evidence that a category causes an effect.

first_failing_public_case_diagnostics.scope: Only the first reported public mismatch per eligible prefix. Whole-output shape errors are not attributed to component algorithms. A component can differ in several tasks; these are descriptive counts, not independent trials or internal-cause diagnoses.

operational_recovery_accounting.scope: Cumulative resources partition into original and new admissions. Historical receipt reconstruction is not a new model call; phase wall times exclude offline recovery preparation.

scope: All contrasts are conditional on the fixed cohort's observed eligible naturally failed prefixes. Unknown prefix eligibility is reported through dispositions, not included as a known failed prefix.
Finite-cohort bounds enumerate missing binary outcomes; they are not confidence intervals. This independent script does not recompute bootstrap intervals or assign confirmatory p-values.

Token units are provider-recorded counts: cached_input is a subset of input_tokens and reasoning is a subset of output. Planning credits and unknown reservations are bookkeeping units, not actual subscription charges or dollars.
Shared prefix and lesson calls are counted once in actual spend. Resource categories partition calls; no overlapping standalone-policy projections are added together.
This checks outcomes from saved public/private receipts and durable accounting. It does not replace isolated source regrading, request replay, or verification of inaccessible provider internals.

Any operational recovery retains the original failed interpretation gate. Descriptive contrasts can span provider time and operational phases; resumption does not turn them into isolated causal estimates.
